cmui - a modern dark look for Championship Manager 01/02
How to install (about 5 minutes)
========================================================

WHAT YOU NEED
- Championship Manager 01/02, version 3.9.68 (the usual patched version).
- Nick's CM0102Patcher (CM0102Patcher.exe). Most players already have it.
- This folder.

BEFORE YOU START
- Close the game.
- Make a backup copy of cm0102.exe (copy it and name the copy cm0102_backup.exe).
  Your saves are never touched by cmui.


STEP 1 - Copy one file into your game folder
---------------------------------------------
Copy  cmui.dll  from this folder into your game folder (the folder with cm0102.exe in it).


STEP 2 - Pick your screen resolution (optional)
-----------------------------------------------
If you want another resolution, do it now in the patcher, as usual:
  Browse (pick your cm0102.exe), tick "Change screen resolution to:", pick a size, Apply.
cmui works at every size the patcher offers (tested at 800x600, 1280x800 and 1680x1050).
You can also change the resolution later; cmui adjusts itself the next time the game starts.


STEP 3 - Add cmui to the game with the patcher
----------------------------------------------
1. Start CM0102Patcher.exe.
2. Click "Browse" and pick your cm0102.exe (skip this if it is already picked).
3. Click "Tools...".
4. Click "Apply Patchfile...".
5. Open the "patches" folder in this cmui folder and pick:
       cmui - Everything.patch
6. The patcher says "Patch applied successfully!". Close the patcher.

That's it. Start the game with cm0102.exe as always.

Want only some of the features? Instead of "cmui - Everything.patch", apply
"cmui Loader.patch" first and then the feature patches you want, one at a time
("cmui - Theme.patch", "cmui - Player Profile.patch", ...). Each .txt next to a patch says
what it does.


PLAYING ONLINE (Hamachi / network games)
----------------------------------------
Everyone in the game (the host and every player who joins) should install cmui, the
same version. The host's computer looks up the club, player and match details that cmui
shows on the other players' screens, so the host needs it too.
Different resolutions per player are fine.

Not cmui, but in the patches folder for network players: "Discipline Player network
fix.patch". With Nick's "Enable idle sensitivity" option on the host, a joined player gets
stuck on the Discipline Player screen. Only the HOST applies it (Tools... > Apply Patchfile...,
like above). The fix is by EertThgil with davdav, from champman0102.co.uk
(viewtopic.php?p=164857).

Also there for network players, applied the same way:
- "Network client font fix.patch": the host and a joined player use different fonts and texts
  such as the club name go missing on the joined player's screen. Only the joined player
  applies it. Works with or without cmui.
- "Network client resolution fix.patch": for a game WITHOUT cmui (cmui already does this): a
  joined player's screen is scaled twice at a higher resolution. Only the joined player
  applies it.


CLUB CRESTS, LEAGUE LOGOS AND FLAGS (optional)
----------------------------------------------
For copyright reasons the pictures are not in this download; you fetch them yourself
once. This needs Python 3 (https://www.python.org/downloads/ - tick "Add python.exe to
PATH" during setup). Then open a command window in this cmui folder and type:
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    python install.py "C:\path\to\your game folder" --crests
It takes a few minutes and writes Data\cmui_crests.bin into your game folder.
Without it, everything else works; you just don't see crests.


TURNING A FEATURE OFF
---------------------
After the first start there is a file cmui.ini in your game folder. Open it with
Notepad, change a 1 to 0 (for example  news=0 ), save, and restart the game.
The names are explained in README.txt.


GETTING RID OF CMUI
-------------------
Put your backup back: delete cm0102.exe and rename cm0102_backup.exe to cm0102.exe.
Then delete cmui.dll, cmui.ini and cmui.log from the game folder.
(Without cmui.dll the game also simply starts without cmui.)


SOMETHING WRONG?
----------------
- The game looks the same as before: cmui.dll is not in the game folder, or the patch
  was applied to another cm0102.exe than the one you start.
- Look at cmui.log in the game folder; it lists what cmui did or could not do.
- On small screens (800x600) the player profile has a "More" button next to ABILITY: it
  swaps the season stats for the reputation, player status and positions panels ("Less"
  swaps back).


NO PATCHER? THE OTHER WAY
-------------------------
With Python installed (see the crests part above) you can let the installer do it
instead of the patcher. It leaves cm0102.exe alone and makes a copy, cm0102_ui.exe,
that you start instead:
    python install.py "C:\path\to\your game folder"
Or drag your game folder onto install.bat.


Thanks to mike_appguy for the design this follows, and to Nick for CM0102Patcher.
cmui is an unofficial fan mod.
